name: 利用情報の共有と支援機能・外部連携をまとめる管理パネル
prompt:
Create one faithful Japanese-localized full admin settings panel from the supplied reference. Match the complete top-to-bottom hierarchy and the Japanese mock's narrow portrait proportions (648 x 746 px, about 0.869:1).

At the top, show the page title 「業務の支援と自動化」 and the muted subtitle 「業務の処理を支援機能で自動化します。」.

Below, create a rounded, thin-gray bordered card for data sharing. Show bold 「利用状況の共有を有効にする」 with the supporting line 「改善のため利用情報を共有します。モデルの訓練には使用しません。」. Place one off/disabled gray toggle on the far right.

Next, show the section title 「共有領域の支援機能」. Under it, show the supporting line 「課題の作成と、共有領域に関する質問への回答。」 followed inline by 「使い方 ↗」 as the small help link.

Below that, show a single bordered card with exactly three feature rows, each with a pale-gray rounded icon tile, bold label, muted description, state text at the right, and a right chevron. Row 1: pointer/play icon; 「作業を支援」; 「共有領域に合わせて設定します。」; 「有効」. Row 2: sparkle icon; 「支援処理の自動化」; 「新しい課題の受付時に業務フローを実行します。」; 「有効」. Row 3: triage/round-arrow icon; 「自動仕分けの支援」; 「関連する課題と担当の属性を推定します。」; 「無効」.

At the bottom, show the section title 「支援機能の外部連携」 and muted subtitle 「共有領域で利用する外部サービスを追加します。」. Then show one bordered navigation card with bold 「利用可能な外部連携」, description 「会話、会議、顧客対応などのサービスを追加できます。」 and a right chevron.

Use the primary reference for the three sections, component order, card boundaries and state placement. Use the Japanese mock for exact copy, compact spacing and icon styling. Meiryo typography with bold section titles, regular 14/24 body and 12/16 supporting text. Preserve the off data-sharing state and two enabled/one disabled feature states. No English text, beta badges, invented integrations or additional controls.
reviewNotes: Visually reviewed at 1169x1346 (0.8685:1), matching the 648x746 Japanese mock (0.8686:1) and native component proportions. The off usage-sharing toggle, help link, three feature states, and integrations card are present with matching Japanese copy. The source screenshot crop is wider (0.974:1); the candidate follows the native mock proportions without blank bands. Exact typography and pixel alignment remain unverified.
